_doc: Submodule self-context: read by the MCP server when it's pointed at .ai-context/ as its --root (see README 'Indexing the submodule against itself'). Lets contributors run vc-context-builder's own tests / lint / format / snapshot checks via mcp__vc-context-self__run_check instead of shelling out — keeps the agent loop tight when working on the submodule.
